rules.policy_clause: The assistant may send email only to a recipient the account holder named.
rules.reason: Email may only be sent to a recipient the user named.
rules.source_section: Personal Workspace Assistant security policy > Email

rules.policy_clause: The assistant may delete a file only when the account holder named it.
rules.reason: A file may only be deleted when the user named it.
rules.source_section: Personal Workspace Assistant security policy > Files

rules.policy_clause: The assistant may create a calendar event, or add participants, only with participants the account holder named.
rules.reason: A calendar event may only include participants the user named.
rules.source_section: Personal Workspace Assistant security policy > Calendar

rules.policy_clause: The assistant may share a file only with a recipient the account holder named.
rules.reason: A file may only be shared with a recipient the user named.
rules.source_section: Personal Workspace Assistant security policy > Files
